Source contracts: scripts/binary_common.py

scripts/binary_common.py

Python · Tier B

Share pinned downloads, safe extraction and subprocess primitives for builds.

Usage

Imported by the native binary builder and its staging helpers.

Inputs

Caller-provided paths/commands, supported native target and checked-in download digests.

Side effects

Runs checked subprocesses; writes requested JSON; caches verified downloads under .build/binary/downloads and extracts build inputs after path/type validation.

Cleanup

Download temporaries are unlinked; callers own extracted trees and persistent caches.
